name: Snatchmon
main_effect: [When Digivolving] You may place up to 2 [Vemmon] from your trash under this Digimon as its bottom digivolution cards. Then, if there are 4 or more [Vemmon] in this Digimon's digivolution cards, return 1 [Fusionize] from your trash to your hand.
source_effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When [Vemmon] is placed from this Digimon's digivolution cards at the bottom of its owner's deck, unsuspend this Digimon, and it gains ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) until the end of your opponent's turn.
